import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    gaps = []
    for i in range(n):
        if i != 0 and even == odd:
            gaps.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i-1]))
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
    gaps.sort()
    count = 0
    for g in gaps:
        if g <= k:
            count += 1
            k -= g
        else:
            break
    sys.stdout.write(str(count))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
